spec_match.rationale: No WebMCP call is made; the code sample uses navigator.modelContext.registerTool with `parameters`/`invoke`, but the spec uses document.modelContext and `inputSchema`/`execute`.

interactive.rationale: Five script buttons and the freestyle input (Enter and Send) all produce trace rows and update the prompts/calls/cart meters, but matching is a keyword lookup over a local array.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Blurb says 'the page's tool registry'; it is a local stub, though the banner admits this.

edge_cases.rationale: Has a no-match branch ('recommend a song'), but keyword matching misroutes: 'update my shipping address' calls addToCart({sku:'item',qty:1}) because 'address' contains 'add'; checkout total ignores qty (3 lines/6 units → 73.5).

references.rationale: Cites the ChromeStatus entry, but the 'WICG Web Model Context' link points at the old WICG repo instead of webmachinelearning/webmcp and the spec.

conformance.rationale: Feature suite (6 assertions) reports 6/6 PASS on CfT 153 both with and without --enable-experimental-web-platform-features; without the flag every assertion passes vacuously (guards like !('modelContext' in document)||…), and registertool-rejects-tool-without-name passes only because reading registerTool off undefined throws TypeError — a false pass that needs a human to review (suite is immutable). The suite targets document.modelContext while this page probes navigator.modelContext.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless Chrome for Testing 153.0.8010.12 driven by Node Playwright (chromium.launch) against a local server on :3111 — NOT chrome-devtools-mcp, which is unavailable in this environment, so this is not DevTools-MCP-verified evidence; no accessibility-tree dump was taken. All 5 scripts plus 3 freestyle prompts driven: meters reached 8 prompts/7 calls; misroute and checkout-total bugs observed in the trace; zero console errors/failed requests; 0px overflow both classes.

design_system.rationale: Uses design-system variables; no raw hex observed; readable in screenshots.

accessibility.rationale: Prompt input has an aria-label and the buttons are native, but the trace and meters have no live region, so results are silent to screen readers.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: 0px overflow at both classes, but 5 of 7 controls are under 44px tall on mobile.

openQuestions.title: Probe the real document.modelContext surface instead of navigator.modelContext and drop origin-trial framing
openQuestions.detail: The current WebMCP spec puts the entry point on Document ([SecureContext, SameObject] readonly attribute ModelContext modelContext) with registerTool(tool, {exposedTo, signal}) → Promise, getTools(), executeTool(tool, inputString) and ontoolchange/ontoolactivated/ontoolcancel; tool callbacks are `execute`, not `handler`/`invoke`. On CfT 153 with --enable-experimental-web-platform-features (also --enable-blink-features=WebMCP or --enable-features=WebMCP) document.modelContext exists and navigator.modelContext does not, so the page's probe/copy is wrong even when the API is live. ChromeStatus lists status 'Proposed', origintrial:false, flag 'Experimental Web Platform features' — replace the 'Origin Trial simulation' banner with the exact chrome://flags/#enable-experimental-web-platform-features steps.

openQuestions.title: Fix keyword misrouting and checkout arithmetic
openQuestions.detail: Repro: freestyle 'update my shipping address' → call addToCart({"sku":"item","qty":1}) and the cart meter increments. Use word-boundary matching. checkout() computes items.length*24.5 and ignores qty.

openQuestions.title: Make the trace an announced log
openQuestions.detail: Give #trace role=log/aria-live=polite (prepend order means newest-first; consider appending for SR order) and expose meters as <output>.

openQuestions.title: Update the code sample and links to current spec vocabulary
openQuestions.detail: Use document.modelContext.registerTool({name, description, inputSchema, execute}) and link webmachinelearning.github.io/webmcp; the 'invoke()' and 'parameters' names are stale.

guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Announce asynchronous/changing results through a polite live region (role=status/log or aria-live) and keep controls as native buttons with accessible names.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Not followed — trace/meters update with no live region.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive control panel without horizontal overflow
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use intrinsic/grid layouts that collapse to one column at narrow widths (minmax(0,1fr), container/media queries) so no fixed-column track forces horizontal overflow.

summary: A fun, honest stub of prompt→tool routing that is clearly labelled as a stub, but it uses stale API vocabulary, never touches document.modelContext, and its keyword matcher misroutes ordinary prompts.
